population.notes: Tier A override: 892 active nests; PDE 904±162 pairs (Murn et al. 2013; Murn & Botha 2016). Kemp 2001 baseline was 1 024–4 096 mature individuals (2^11).

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

kempBaseline.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^11=2048 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 1024–4096.
